| description = Leader of the Drixie sect of the Tunarean Court. Located anywhere [[A Drixie Thane]] might be. Killing drixies incurs a negative faction hit to [[Tunarean Court]].

To spawn him, go to the dragon circle and track drixie thanes. A druid will see 3 wanderers from there. Pull them, dot them fully, and then either gate when they are low on health, or camp out, timing it so that you camp out a tick or two before the mob dies. For a mob to die of a dot after you zone out, it has to either die on the very next tick, or the dots have to be doing more than 5% per tick, because the mob will begin to regen health by 5% per tick as soon as it loses all aggro.

Lord Prismwing is rare, or can be if you're unlucky. I killed approximately 70 drixie thanes before he spawned.
